Resolves #21771

`balancedShard()` dealt every file in one greedy longest-first pass, so unmeasured specs — all priced at the table's p90 fallback (38.5s) — sorted ahead of every measured file below p90 while the pass was still placing the heaviest measured specs first. With 44 new specs missing from `e2eEngineDurations.json` (287 `enginePaths()` vs 243 table entries), shard 1/15 (which starts with the 166.4s `WorkstationFilmTourNL` spec) received only 1 unmeasured spec of fallback headroom while shards 5/15 and 6/15 absorbed 4 each, concentrating 328.6s of real measured work on shard 1 vs 213.1s on shard 5 — and shard 1 hit the 6-minute ceiling with 100% of tests passing (jobs 136782504763, 136792762453).

This PR (1) sorts unmeasured files (`!(path in durations)`) ahead of measured ones in `balancedShard()`, so K unmeasured files are dealt `floor(K/M)..ceil(K/M)` per shard before the measured files are balanced longest-first on top; (2) rebuilds `e2eEngineDurations.json` from 7 completed green full-matrix runs so all 287 `enginePaths()` files carry a measured duration; and (3) pins the behavior with a new deterministic unit arm. No public behavior change — CI shard planning only.

Evidence: L2 (unit/spec tests run locally: 27/27 in E2eCiSelection.spec.mjs, 552/552 in test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/util) -> L3 required (CI e2e-engine shards staying under the 6-minute ceiling on the next full-matrix runs).

| AC-2 | `buildScripts/util/e2eEngineDurations.json` rebuilt via `node buildScripts/util/e2eCiSelection.mjs --engine-durations` from 7 completed green full-matrix runs of 2026-11-21 — `44903302345`, `44900670601`, `44883471766`, `44883100147`, `44880123498`, `44878141569`, `44876901023` (each verified `conclusion=success` with 15 `e2e-engine (N/15)` jobs), keeping only files the dev tree holds per `learn/guides/testing/WhiteboxE2E.md`. Result: 287 entries, every `enginePaths()` file covered, 0 missing |
| AC-3 | Per-shard planned seconds (15 shards over the 287 specs, computed with `enginePaths` + `balancedShard`). Before (stale 243-entry table, dev ordering): `367,368,367,368,367,368,367,368,367,368,368,368,367,368,368` — max 368s, over the 360s ceiling. After this PR (rebuilt 287-entry table + unmeasured-first ordering): `292,291,292,292,292,292,291,291,291,292,292,291,291,292,291` — max 292s, spread 1s, 68s of headroom. Stale-table per-shard known-seconds range: before the ordering fix `213.1-328.6s` (shard 1 = 328.6s), after `251.6-291.4s` |
